question: In November 2024, India sent a formal Letter of Intent to the International Olympic Committee to host the Olympics and Paralympics in which of the following years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2036**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In November 2024, India sent a formal Letter of Intent to the International Olympic Committee (IOC) to host the Olympics and Paralympics in the year 2036.
 
• The Indian government expressed its ambition to bring the prestigious event to India, showcasing its readiness and infrastructure capabilities.
 
• The bid aligns with India's growing influence and capabilities in the international sports arena.
 
• The proposed host city for the 2036 Olympics and Paralympics is Ahmedabad, which is being developed as a smart city with world-class facilities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Olympic Committee (IOC)**

 
 
• The IOC is the governing body of the Olympic Movement, headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland.
 
• It was founded on 23 June 1894 by Pierre de Coubertin and Demetrios Vikelas.
 
• The IOC is responsible for organizing the Summer and Winter Olympic Games every four years.
 
• It also oversees the Youth Olympic Games and other associated events.
 
 
 
• **Olympics and Paralympics**
 
 
• The Olympics are a major international multi-sport event divided into summer and winter games.
 
• The Paralympics are a series of international contests for athletes with disabilities, held after the Olympic Games.
 
• Both events promote unity, excellence, and fair play among athletes worldwide.
 
• The Paralympic Games are overseen by the International Paralympic Committee (IPC), which works closely with the IOC.
 
 
 
• **Ahmedabad as a Smart City**
 
 
• Ahmedabad, located in the state of Gujarat, is one of India's fastest-growing cities.
 
• The city has seen significant infrastructure development, making it a viable candidate for hosting large-scale international events.
 
• Ahmedabad is home to the Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Stadium, one of the largest cricket stadiums in the world.
 
• The city's smart city initiatives include improved urban planning, transportation systems, and public services.
